command_not_found_enabled.description: Whether to enable the command-not-found handler (i.e., show helpful hints when an unknown command is typed).

command_not_found_path.description: Full path to the command-not-found handler script used by PackageKit.

max_concurrent_lookups.description: Maximum number of simultaneous command-not-found lookups allowed (to avoid overwhelming the package manager).

allowed_sources.description: List of package sources (repositories) allowed to provide command-not-found suggestions. Leave empty to allow all sources. Each item is a repository name (e.g., 'fedora', 'updates').

lookup_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for each command-not-found lookup before timing out.

verbose.description: Whether to emit detailed debug logging for command-not-found operations.
